name: paceline
description: Keeps a Claude Code session and its subscription limits in shape. context-watch (on by default): shows the agent its context against the auto-compaction point, warns before compaction and snapshots the session at each one. cache-watch (per session, on request): wakes an idle session before its one-hour prompt cache expires. pace (off until turned on): a per-hour budget against the five-hour and weekly limits, advice before Agent and Workflow launches, subagent reservations and a night queue. usage-watch (off until turned on): reads the account's exact usage and its model-scoped weekly limits through Claude Code every 125 seconds, so the limits stay current while sessions are idle. Keeps the limit readings in ~/.claude/state/paceline/rate-limits.json. Requires Claude Code 2.1.287+ and Python 3.9+.
